newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT-Cocoa likely to falter on upside.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT-Cocoa likely to falter on upside.

text.p: Close * Support * Resist * RSI14 * MA10 * MA40
Cocoa futures could edge up but the upward momentum could falter before the key 1,070 stg resistance basis September, technical analysts said on Friday.
Traders called the market to open unchanged.
Trevor Neil, a senior technical analyst at Union Cal Futures, said the September contract faced resistance at the top of the March-April trading range of 1,072.
If this were to break the level would become support and the market would move up further to test the chart gap up to 1,108 stg which was established on June 2.
"But most likely it will fail before the 1,072 resistance and ease back to the bottom of the (current) range at 1,000," Neil said.
But broker GNI said London cocoa found significant resistance at 1,061, Thursday's high.
"Now would be a good time to sell short with a tight stop," it said in a commentary.
London's September closed three stg down at 1,054 stg but well above its intraday low of 1,042.

There was little fundamental news but analysts noted good weather conditions for the development of the Indonesian mid-crop cocoa and the Ivorian main crop. --Jalil Hamid, London newsroom +44 171 542 4985
